红丸（红丸（第22页）我很想打电话给苏墨求证，然而，拿起电话，我却怎么也拨不出去。结婚这天，爸爸出院回家了，当我穿着婚纱站在家里的镜子前，我依旧是恍惚的，像是梦一般不真实，这是我第二次穿上婚纱，却都是嫁给自己不喜欢的人。短暂的停顿之后，手机再次响起，我看了眼，是爸爸打来的电话，我的眼睛一沉，感觉很不好。“没有，我没有当你是玩物。”苏迫切的解释，因为过于急躁，他一口气没上来咳嗽起来。包包里有手机和钱包，钱包里钱倒是不多，只是钱包里有一张她和顾东玦的结婚照，丢了有点可惜。这就是联邦顶层的对话，任何一句都是一条惊天新闻。然而洪世襄就这么说了出来，双方属下眼皮子直抽。翌日，顾氏外千金跳楼的消息登上了各个新闻的头条，早起有看新闻习惯的乔静微看到内容之后，震惊不已。会长对于这件事的态度实在让人意外，他不仅没有鼓励大家的拉拢计划，反倒是叫他们暂时不要代表公会和林潇有任何接触。顾西西不知道自己站了多久，只见那明亮的落地窗外，大大的云朵已经随风移动的不见踪影。而唯一的家属又是一个孩子，他们便先提供公司的卡，走公账，到时再取出来送去医院。这样也可以防止钱被银行卡住的情况，没想到萧雨竟然误会了，他们很抱歉什么的。总之，这钱多少，他们会公布出来。“巴德？你怎么来了？”看着面前前天才离开的战友，莱卡斯很是意外。周言撇着嘴冷声回了云浩棉一句以后，他便径直朝着那座阴森气息十足的峡谷里面走了进去。

Red Pill (Red Pill (Page 22)) I really wanted to call Su Mo for verification, but when I picked up the phone, I couldn't make a call. On the wedding day, my father came home from the hospital. When I stood in front of the mirror at home wearing a wedding dress, I was still in a trance, as unreal as a dream. This was the second time I put on a wedding dress, but I married someone I didn't like. After a short pause, the phone rang again. I looked at it, and it was a call from my father. My eyes sank, and I felt Very bad. "No, I didn't treat you as a plaything." Su explained urgently. He couldn't help but cough because he was too impatient. There was a mobile phone and a wallet in the bag. There wasn't much money in the wallet, but there was a picture of her and Gu. It was a pity to lose Dongjue's wedding photos. This was a conversation at the top of the federation. However, when Hong Shixiang said this, the eyes of both parties were twitching. It was on the headlines of various news, and Qiao Jingwei, who had a habit of reading the news early in the morning, was shocked when she saw the content. The president's attitude towards this matter was really surprising. Not only did he not encourage everyone's wooing plan, he actually told them not to have any contact with Lin Xiao on behalf of the guild. Gu Xixi didn't know how long he stood there, and saw that the big clouds had disappeared with the wind outside the bright floor-to-ceiling window. And the only family member was a child. Provide the company's card and take it out to the hospital. Unexpectedly, Xiao Yu misunderstood and they were sorry. Anyway, they will announce the amount. "Bud? Why are you here?" Looking at the comrade who left just the day before, Zhou Yan said coldly to Yun Haomian, and then walked straight into the eerie canyon.
